steps.text: Wash and properly dry the ripest strawberries and chill.
Pile them into a glass bowl with a tiny dish of caster sugar for dipping.
Open a very cold bottle of sparkling wine alongside.
Mash the butter with crushed garlic, chopped parsley, finely chopped shallot and a splash of brandy.
Put the escargot in a baking dish and cover each one with the butter.
Bake at 200C until sizzling. Serve with baguette.

dish.n: Business dinner eye fillet and red wine jus

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin and prepare the shallots and beans.
Layer the potatoes with the cream, crushed garlic and salt, and bake at 160C.
Sear the eye fillet on all sides, then roast at 200C to 54C inside.
Rest the beef. Chop the shallots and soften in the pan.
Add the wine and reduce by half, then add the stock and reduce until glossy. Whisk in some of the butter.
Steam the beans and toss with the remaining butter.
Chill the bottle in an ice bucket.
Drop a sugar cube into each of four flutes and soak with bitters.
Add the brandy, then slowly top with champagne.
Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.

dish.make_ahead: Chill the bottles at least 3 hours ahead

steps.text: Chill the bottles of lager in the fridge for at least 3 hours, then keep them cold in a tub of ice.
Pour the lager into heavy glass steins straight down the middle so each gets a proper head.
Put one large ice cube in each of 4 short glasses.
Pour 30ml Canadian rye whisky over the ice in each glass.
Add a small splash of cold water to each to open up the whisky and serve.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water to make syrup.
For each drink, stir rye, syrup and bitters over ice for 30 seconds and strain over a large cube.
Twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
Soak the fruit in the brandy overnight.
Cream the butter and sugar and beat in the eggs.
Fold in the fruit, flour, spice and almonds.
Bake in a lined tin at 150C.
Cool and slice thin.
Fill 4 tall glasses with ice.
Add the bourbon and lime juice to each.
Top with ginger beer and stir once.
Add a lime wedge and a cinnamon stick. Skip the bourbon for the non drinkers.

dish.n: Joi's rib eye, mash and red wine jus

steps.text: Boil the potatoes and mash with butter.
Reduce the red wine with stock into a jus.
Sear the steaks hard.
Rest and slice the steaks.
Steam the green beans.
Plate it like a proper dinner and pour the jus over.
Stir the honey into hot water to loosen and cool.
Fill four tall glasses with ice and add Scotch, honey syrup and lemon juice, then stir.
Top each with ginger ale and stir once more.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over the top and drop it in.
Cut the onions into thick rings and soak in the buttermilk.
Whisk the flour with the cold lager into a batter.
Dip the rings in the batter and fry at 185C in batches until puffed and golden.
Salt and serve hot.
Chill the lager and lemonade until very cold.
Fill a large jug with ice and add the lemon and lime wedges, squeezing as they go in.
Pour in the lager and lemonade together, slowly. Stir once and pour into big glasses.
Brown the chicken skin side down in oil
Add the garlic, thyme and wine
Cover and bake at 180C
Squeeze the soft garlic onto slices of crusty bread and eat with the chicken

dish.n: Holy water lemon, lime and bitters

steps.text: Squeeze the limes and lemon
Fill glasses with crushed ice
Add lime juice, lemon juice and bitters to each
Top with cold lemonade, stir once and drop in a lime wedge. For the bottle look, mix it all in a jug and pour into small glass bottles before serving over ice
Pound the chicken thin, cut in half, then flour.
Boil the pasta until tender and drain.
Sear the chicken in oil until golden and cooked through.
Add the wine, lemon juice and capers and reduce.
Whisk in the butter. Toss the pasta through and serve the chicken on top.
Chill the flutes.
Shake the gin, lemon juice and syrup with ice.
Strain into the flutes and top with sparkling wine, pouring slowly.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass and drop it in.
Brew the coffee, cool and add the liqueur.
Whisk the yolks with the sugar, then fold in the mascarpone and whipped cream.
Dip the savoiardi quickly and layer with the cream in a dish.
Set overnight in the fridge.
Sift cocoa on top.
Stir the gin, aperitivo and vermouth over ice for 20 seconds, one drink at a time.
Strain over a big cube and twist orange peel over the top.

ingredients.item: rib eye steak, in four pieces

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry the frites in oil at 140C, then drain and cool.
Fry again at 185C until crisp. Season with salt.
Pat the steaks dry and season. Sear in a heavy pan on both sides, then rest.
Add the pepper to the pan, then carefully add the brandy away from the flame. Add the stock and reduce.
Add the cream and simmer. Serve the steaks with the sauce and frites.
Put a sugar cube in each flute and shake bitters onto each. Add cognac, top slowly with chilled champagne and twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass.
Cut the chicken into pieces and mix with the soy, sake, ginger and crushed garlic.
Marinate in the fridge.
Coat in potato starch and fry at 160C, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until crisp.
Serve with mayonnaise and lemon.
Pack four tall glasses with ice.
Add the whisky to each and top with very cold soda water.
Stir once and add a twist of lemon. Sip it slowly, jet-lagged, at the hotel bar.
Peel the potatoes, slice the mushrooms and chop the tarragon.
Brown the chicken in oil.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the wine and simmer.
Stir in the cream and tarragon.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and steam the beans.
Squeeze the oranges and strain the juice.
Chill the juice and the sparkling wine.
Pour orange juice into each of four flutes, then slowly top with sparkling wine.
Twist a strip of orange peel over each and hang on the rim. For non-drinkers, top with sparkling water.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 weeks, keep wrapped and reheat by steaming

steps.text: Soak the dried fruit in the brandy overnight.
Beat the butter and sugar, beat in the eggs, then mix in the breadcrumbs, flour, spice and the soaked fruit.
Pack into a greased pudding basin, cover and steam.
Warm the extra brandy, light it and pour over at the table. Serve with warm custard.
Whisk the egg yolks with the sugar.
Heat the milk and cream, pour over the yolks and stir over low heat to 75C.
Chill well.
Stir in the brandy and grate fresh nutmeg on top.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Soak the peaches in the brandy and brown sugar.
Butter the bread and layer with the peaches in a baking dish.
Whisk the eggs with the milk and vanilla and pour over.
Rest so the bread soaks up the custard.
Bake at 170C until set and golden. Serve warm.
Brew the coffee strong.
Lightly whip the cream until just thick.
Put brown sugar and peach brandy into 4 diner mugs, pour in hot coffee and stir. Spoon a little cream on top and serve straight away.
Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry well. Whisk the batter flour, cornflour and cold lager together.
Fry the chips in oil at 140C until pale and soft, then drain.
Cook the peas, then crush with the butter and chopped mint and keep warm.
Dust the fish in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C in batches until golden and crisp.
Fry the chips again at 185C until crisp. Salt well and serve with the fish, peas and malt vinegar.

dish.make_ahead: Mix the base up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Juice the limes and orange.
Shake the cranberry juice, lime juice, orange juice and syrup with ice, then strain into 4 short glasses of crushed ice. Top with soda and a lime wedge. Add vodka first for the grown-up version.
Drain the cherries, keeping some of the syrup.
Melt the butter with the sugar in a wide pan, add the syrup and the orange zest and juice and simmer.
Stir in the cornflour mixed with water, then add the cherries and warm through.
Off the heat, pour in the brandy and carefully light it with a long match. Let the flames die down.
Spoon over scoops of ice cream.
Boil water in a kettle.
In each heatproof mug put honey, lemon juice, bourbon and a cinnamon stick.
Top with hot water and stir until the honey dissolves. Stud a lemon slice with cloves and float it on top.
Slice the chorizo and fry until crisp.
Add a splash of red wine and cook until sticky.
Cut the Manchego into triangles and top each with a sliver of quince paste.
Warm the olives with strips of orange peel.
Serve everything on small plates.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day chilled, add soda just before serving

steps.text: Slice the oranges and apple into a large jug.
Pour in the red wine, brandy and orange juice.
Chill for 2 hours so the fruit soaks it up.
Top with cold soda water just before pouring into glasses over ice.

dish.n: Molly Brown's first class filet mignon

steps.text: Layer the potatoes with melted butter in a pan, season and bake at 200C for 50 minutes for pommes Anna.
Tie the steaks, sear in butter and roast to 54C.
Reduce the shallots, wine and stock to a sauce in the steak pan.
Steam the beans and serve everything together.

dish.n: Black velvet, stout and sparkling wine

steps.text: Half fill four tall glasses with stout, poured slowly so it settles.
Top each slowly with sparkling wine poured over the back of a spoon so it sits on top. Serve straight away.
Rub the beef with the garlic, pepper, oil and salt.
Roast at 220C, then lower to 180C for medium rare.
Rest the beef.
Parboil the potatoes, rough up, toss in duck fat and roast.
Simmer the pan juices with the wine and stock until reduced by half.
Mix the sour cream with the horseradish and a squeeze of lemon.
Chill the pint glasses.
Pour the stout into each glass at an angle, then straighten up to build a creamy head. Let it settle before topping up.
Pour a measure of whisky into shot glasses and serve alongside.
For non-drinkers, fill glasses with ice, add a squeeze of lime and dashes of bitters and top with cola.
Parboil the potatoes, then shake to rough up.
Roast in hot oil at 220C until crisp.
Season the steaks and sear in a very hot pan, basting with butter for the last minute.
Rest the steaks.
In the same pan add the peppercorns and brandy, then cream and stock, and simmer until thick.
Slice and spoon the sauce over.
Put the martini glasses in the freezer.
Fill a jug with ice, add gin and vermouth and stir steadily until very cold.
Strain into the frozen glasses and add a toothpick with two olives to each.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Shake the bourbon, lemon juice, the cooled syrup and egg white hard without ice, then again with ice.
Strain into 4 ice-filled rocks glasses. Add bitters to each foam and a cherry.
Fill 4 pot glasses with ice.
Add the cordial, lemon juice and bitters to each.
Top with lemonade, stir once and add a lemon wedge. A pot of lager on the side for anyone after one.

dish.n: Drover's rum and ginger beer billy punch
dish.make_ahead: Tea can be chilled a day ahead

steps.text: Brew the tea and chill.
Mix the tea with the rum, lime juice and sugar, stirring to dissolve.
Add plenty of ice and top with ginger beer.
Ladle into mugs with a lime wedge and mint. Leave out the rum for a booze free pot.
Combine the wine, brandy, sugar, orange, apple and cinnamon in a large jug. Stir to dissolve the sugar.
Chill for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with lemonade. Pour into glasses with some of the fruit in each.
Cube the baguette and apple and toss the cheese with cornflour.
Rub a pot with the cut garlic clove.
Warm the wine, then stir in the cheese gradually until smooth.
Keep warm over low heat and dip in the baguette and apple.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, add ice at serving

steps.text: Mix the wine, pomegranate juice, brandy, sugar and cinnamon in a big jug.
Add the oranges and pomegranate seeds.
Chill for at least two hours.
Add plenty of ice and top with soda water just before serving.

film: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid (1969)

steps.text: Dry shake the bourbon, lemon juice, syrup and egg whites.
Add ice and shake hard.
Strain into glasses over ice.
Shake bitters onto the foam and add a cherry.
Cut the oranges into small wedges.
For each drink, muddle 3 orange wedges, mint leaves and brown sugar syrup in a shaker.
Add bourbon, lemon juice and ice and shake hard.
Strain over crushed ice in a rocks glass and garnish with an orange wheel and a mint sprig. For non-drinkers, swap the bourbon for fresh orange juice topped with soda.
Mix the salt with the chilli powder on a saucer. Rub the glass rims with lime and dip in the salt.
Fill the glasses with ice. Add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire to each.
Top slowly with cold lager, stir once and serve with a lime wedge.
Whisk the yolks and sugar until pale.
Warm the milk, cream and nutmeg until steaming, then slowly whisk into the yolks.
Return to the pan and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon, without boiling.
Cool, then stir in the bourbon.
Chill.
Pour into tumblers and grate fresh nutmeg on top.

dish.n: Fight Man rematch lemon, lime and bitters

steps.text: Fill 4 glasses with ice.
Add lime cordial and bitters to each, top with lemonade and stir until it turns pink.
Garnish with lemon and lime wedges.

film: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald (2018)

steps.text: Peel the onions and potatoes and slice the mushrooms.
Brown the chicken and lardons.
Add the onions and mushrooms, then the wine, stock and thyme.
Simmer covered.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter.

dish.make_ahead: Best made the night before, keep chilled

steps.text: Put the sponge chunks in a trifle bowl and drizzle with the sherry.
Make up the jelly following the packet, pour it over the sponge and chill until set.
Spoon over the custard, then the whipped cream. Chill overnight so it settles.
Top with the raspberries just before serving.
Pour the bottle of red wine into a saucepan with the honey, the cinnamon stick, the black peppercorns, the bay leaves and the strips of orange peel.
Warm gently over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring until the honey dissolves.
Do not let it boil.
Strain into heavy cups.
For non-drinkers, make it the same way with red grape juice and less honey.
For each drink, measure 50ml whisky, the juice of 1 lemon, 15ml sugar syrup, 1 egg white and 1 dash bitters into a shaker.
Shake each drink without ice for 10 seconds.
Add ice and shake again, then strain into a short glass over fresh ice.
Shake drops of bitters onto the foam. For the sober version, make iced tea with lemon and honey.

dish.n: Hanna's three-hour beef and pork ragù

steps.text: Soften the diced onion, carrot and celery in the oil.
Add both minces and brown hard.
Pour in the wine and reduce, then add the tomatoes, parmesan rind and water.
Simmer gently, topping up with water.
Cook the rigatoni and toss through the ragu with a splash of pasta water.
Grate the parmesan over.
Muddle half the peach slices with the syrup, lemon juice and mint leaves in a shaker.
Add the bourbon and ice and shake hard.
Strain into tumblers packed with crushed ice and garnish with a peach slice and a mint sprig.
Fill four tall glasses with crushed ice.
Into each pour the vodka, blue curacao and lime juice, then top with chilled lemonade and stir gently.
Garnish with a lime wheel. For a booze-free version, swap the vodka and curacao for blue cordial and extra lime.
Simmer the honey, water and ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Add whisky, ginger syrup and lime juice to each.
Top with ginger ale, stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.
Brew the coffee. Stir the sugar into each cup until dissolved.
Add the whiskey for the grown-ups.
Lightly whip the cream until just thick and pour it gently over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.
Fill tall glasses with ice
Squeeze lime juice into each and add the ginger beer
Pour the rum slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats dark on top
Add a lime wedge and serve unstirred. Skip the rum for a plain ginger beer and lime
Chill four martini glasses in the freezer.
Make strong espresso or coffee and cool.
Cool.
Shake two drinks at a time with vodka, liqueur, coffee, syrup and ice for 20 seconds.
Strain into the glasses and float three coffee beans on the foam. Repeat.

dish.make_ahead: Purée up to 1 day, top with sparkling wine just before serving

steps.text: Crush most of the raspberries with the sugar and lemon juice and push through a sieve.
Spoon a spoonful of purée into each of 4 flutes.
Slowly top with cold sparkling wine and drop a whole raspberry in each.
Stir the gin and vermouth over plenty of ice until very cold, one drink at a time.
Strain into chilled martini glasses and add a green olive on a pick.

ingredients.item: bottles Mexican style lager (330 ml each)

steps.text: Mix the salt with the chilli powder on a plate.
Rub the rims of 4 tall glasses with lime and dip into the salt. Fill with ice.
Into each glass add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire.
Top slowly with cold lager, stir gently and add a lime wedge. Use soda water instead of beer for anyone not drinking.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides (2011)

steps.text: Juice the limes and cut the pineapple into wedges.
Mix the rum, coconut water, pineapple juice, lime juice and syrup in a jug.
Fill four glasses with crushed ice and pour in the punch.
Grate nutmeg over the top and add a pineapple wedge.

dish.make_ahead: Purée up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Peel and stone the peaches, blend with the lemon juice and sugar until smooth.
Chill the purée for 30 minutes.
Spoon some purée into each chilled flute and top slowly with prosecco poured down the side. Stir once and serve straight away.

dish.make_ahead: Grapefruit soda up to 1 day, chilled

steps.text: Juice the grapefruit and stir with the sugar until dissolved.
Mix with the soda water and chill well.
Half fill 4 tall glasses with lager.
Top with the grapefruit soda and add a wedge. Serve the soda on its own for the drivers.
Keep the vodka in the freezer overnight.
Fill four mugs with crushed ice and add vodka, cranberry juice and lime juice to each.
Top with cold ginger beer and stir once.
Drop in frozen cranberries and a rosemary sprig.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool to make syrup.
In each tall glass, gently muddle mint with some syrup and lime juice.
Add rum, fill with crushed ice, top with soda and stir.
Put 4 pint glasses in the freezer for the chilling time.
Juice the limes and slice the apple very thin.
Pour lager into each glass, top with apple juice and a squeeze of lime, then float apple slices. For non-drinkers, use ginger beer in place of the lager.

dish.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week, build fresh

steps.text: Stir the honey into the warm water to make a syrup.
For each drink, stir the bourbon, syrup and bitters with ice, then strain over one big ice cube.
Twist a strip of orange peel over the top.

dish.n: Catalina Wine Mixer strawberry rosé spritz

steps.text: Slice the strawberries and divide between four large wine glasses.
Add elderflower cordial and a squeeze of lemon to each and press lightly.
Fill with ice, pour in the cold rose and top with soda water.
Stir gently and add a lemon wheel.
Whisk the eggs with the sugar until thick, then fold in the flour and cocoa
Bake at 175C
Cool and split the cake
Brush with cherry syrup and kirsch
Whip the cream and layer with the cherries
Shave dark chocolate on top

dish.n: Alfred's smoky Scotch and ginger sour

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and ginger, then cool and strain.
For each drink shake Scotch, lemon juice and syrup hard over ice.
Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler.
Float the smoky whisky on top and garnish with candied ginger.

dish.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool to make syrup.
Chill four coupes.
For each drink, shake rum, lime juice and syrup hard with plenty of ice, then double strain into a coupe.

film: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug (2013)

steps.text: Warm the honey with the water until runny.
Cool the honey syrup.
Shake the first batch with ice: half the milk, bourbon, honey and vanilla, then strain into two cups.
Repeat for the second batch.
Grate fresh nutmeg over the top. For a non-drinking version, leave out the bourbon and add a pinch of cinnamon.

ingredients.item: sparkling apple juice (for anyone not drinking)

steps.text: Pour the wine into a saucepan with the orange juice, honey, spices and orange slices.
Heat gently, keeping it below a simmer so the alcohol stays.
Ladle into mugs with an orange slice each. For anyone not drinking, warm sparkling apple juice with the same spices.
Chill four coupes
For each drink, measure 40ml vodka, 15ml orange liqueur, 30ml cranberry juice and the juice of half a lime into a shaker.
Shake each drink with ice for 15 seconds
Strain into the coupes
Hold a strip of orange peel over each glass, warm it with a match and squeeze so the oil flashes, then drop it in

film: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three (1974)

dish.n: Mr Green's honey lemon whisky toddy

steps.text: Thinly slice the ginger and juice the lemons, keeping a few wheels.
Into each of 4 heatproof glasses put whisky, honey, lemon juice and ginger slices, top with boiling water and stir until the honey dissolves. Add a lemon wheel and a cinnamon stick.

dish.n: Never-empty mug of honey lager punch

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and ginger, then cool and strain.
Chill a large jug.
Mix the syrup, lemon juice and apple juice in the jug.
Slowly pour in the lager and stir gently once.
Pour into big mugs with a lemon wheel and keep a second jug ready.
Freeze the flesh of the ripe mangoes in chunks for at least 2 hours.
Mix the salt with a little chilli flakes, wet the rims of the glasses with lime and dip.
Blend the frozen mango with the white rum, the lime juice, the sugar syrup and the ice until thick and slushy.
Pour into the glasses and add a lime wheel.
Leave out the rum and add the coconut water for non-drinkers.
Juice the limes and rim four glasses with salt.
Shake the tequila, orange liqueur and lime juice hard with ice, one drink at a time.
Strain into the glasses.

dish.make_ahead: Chill the bottle at least 3 hours ahead

steps.text: Chill the bottle of champagne or sparkling wine in the fridge for at least 3 hours.
Sit the bottle in an ice bucket with the ice and a little cold water while you wait for midnight.
Open the champagne just before midnight and pour into four flutes.
Dice the onions and carrots.
Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Soften the vegetables, return the beef with red wine and water to cover and simmer.
Boil the potatoes and mash with plenty of butter.
Cook the potatoes.
Spoon the stew over the mash.
